scenes.text: The first person to go over Niagara Falls in a barrel was a sixty three year old teacher.
Her name was Annie Edson Taylor, and she did it on her birthday, October twenty fourth, nineteen oh one.
Her barrel was made of oak and iron, and padded with a mattress.
Two days earlier, a cat was sent over the falls in the same barrel, and it survived.
Annie came out alive, with only a small cut on her head.
She hoped the stunt would make her rich, but her manager ran off with the barrel.
Would you ever get in that barrel?

title: She went over Niagara Falls in a barrel at 63 🛢️
caption: On October 24, 1901, her 63rd birthday, Annie Edson Taylor became the first person to survive a trip over Niagara Falls in a barrel. A cat had tested the barrel two days earlier! 🛢️
